number_of_fractions: Afterwards, ODG fractions of 1 mL were collected from the top of the gradient and pooled (1–5, 6–8, 9–10, 11–12, 13–14, 15–16), diluted to 16 mL in PBS in a 17 mL Thinwall Polypropylene Tube (Beckman Coulter) and centrifuged for 3 h at 100,000 g (acceleration: max; deceleration: max) and 4°C (SW 32.1 Ti rotor with ravg = 11.36 cm and adjusted k-factor = 298.0, Beckman Coulter).
number_of_technical_replicates: Three repeated runs per sample were performed.
technology_type: Mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis of urinary EV (uEV) in men with benign and malignant prostate disease allowed us to significantly expand the known human uEV proteome with high specificity and identifies a unique biological profile in prostate cancer not uncovered by the analysis of soluble proteins.
